Full-body imposing Full Annual Cycle, a vast winged machine on long jointed legs with a wide fan of bronze paper feathers. Its spread wings and separated baskets form a clear, monumental silhouette; brass pins mark every joint. Low viewpoint, whole figure in frame against a subdued tan clearing; no lettering.
